headline: Indian Government Updates Supreme Court On Air India Crash Probe
seoTitle: Update Provided on Air India Crash Investigation
metaDescription: Indian authorities informed the Supreme Court that the investigation into the 2025 Air India crash at Ahmedabad Airport is reaching its conclusion.
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities notified the Supreme Court that the official investigation into the 2025 flight crash is nearing completion.
The inquiry is being conducted by the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau.
The June 2025 aviation accident at Ahmedabad Airport resulted in the deaths of 229 passengers and 12 crew members.
aiContextParagraph: The Indian government has provided a status update to the Supreme Court regarding the ongoing investigation into the fatal Air India flight 171 crash. The incident, which occurred on June 12, 2025, at the Ahmedabad Airport, involved a significant loss of life, with 229 passengers and 12 crew members reported deceased. The probe into the causes and circumstances surrounding the crash is being carried out by the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau. Officials stated that the investigation process is currently in its final stages. While the government has indicated that the report is at the fag end of completion, no specific timeline for the public release of the official findings has been provided. The court is monitoring the progress of the inquiry as families and stakeholders await the final assessment of the catastrophic aviation event.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating through reports from two independent national outlets following updates provided during legal proceedings at the Supreme Court.
